newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND'S CAMPBELL PLEDGES FUTURE TO SPURS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND'S CAMPBELL PLEDGES FUTURE TO SPURS.

text.p: England defender Sol Campbell pledged his immediate future to Tottenham on Wednesday by signing a new four-year deal with the club.
"I'm a Tottenham man. I've been here since I was 14 and I'm happy to be here for another four years," he said. "We want success at this club and the fans want success."
Campbell, 22, has been capped five times for England.
